Total number of questions — 15
1
Employment of women in defence
forces
*1. SHRI TIRUCHI SIVA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
 state:
(a) the number of women employed in
the three wings of the defence forces, i.e.
Army, Air Force and Navy;
(b) whether there has been an increase
in the number of women joining the defence
forces during the last three years and during
the current year; and
(c) details of the schemes being
introduced by Government to incentivise
women and increase their participation in
the defence forces?
Synthetic Hockey Surface in Bijapur,
Karnataka
*2. SHRI K.C. RAMAMURTHY: Will
the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) the date on which Ministry
approved the laying of Synthetic Hockey
Surface at Sainik School, Bijapur, Karnataka;
(b) the initial estimated cost of the
project;
(c) the amount so far released and the
status of work; and
(d) by when the surface would be
completed and would become operational?
Arsenic contamination in drinking
water
*3. SHRI RAVI PRAKASH VERMA:
Will the Minister of DRINKING WATER
AND SANITATION  be pleased to state:
(a) the mechanism adopted by integrated
Management Information System of the
Ministry to compile data regarding the
number of people affected by Arsenic
contaminated drinking water in the country;

2
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether there is any mechanism
under the Ministry to verify and cross-
check the data with ground realities;
(c) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(d) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the details of people/households
affected by Arsenic, Fluoride and Mercury
contamination in drinking water who have
been provided with safe drinking water
during the last three years, State-wise?
Status of Rural Housing Scheme
†*4. DR. SATY ANARAYAN JA TIYA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state the
details of houses constructed and rural
amenties provided under rural housing
scheme for the last three years till the year
2018, State-wise?
Highways development in Andhra
Pradesh
*5. SHRI T.G. VENKATESH: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
construct Highways in the State of Andhra
Pradesh with an investment of one lakh
crores; if so, the details thereof;
(b) the details of the highway projects
being taken up particularly in the
Rayalaseema region; and
(c) the quantum of funds allocated for
this purpose?
New bids for Air Force contracts
*6. SHRI PARTAP SINGH BAJWA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the current deal for 36
Rafale Jets is separate from the earlier deal
for 126 Jets sought by the UPA
Government;
(b) whether any new bids were solicited
or considered for the deal concluded by
Government, including proposals for the
Eurofighter Typhoon Jet;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons for Government
considering the old bidding process, made
in 2007, to still be valid for a deal concluded
in 2016?
Construction of Highways
†*7. MS. SAROJ PANDEY: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state
comparative details of the total length of
roads, in kilometres, which were being
constructed per day prior to 2014 and the
length of roads constructed after the year
2014?
Approval of designs of Polavaram
Project
*8. DR. K. V . P. RAMACHANDRRA
RAO: Will the Minister of W ATER
RESOURCES, RIVER DEVELOPMENT
AND GANGA REJUVENATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
several designs relating to Polavaram Head
Works like Spill Channel, Divide Wall,

3

by Central Water Commission (CWC),
though the project needs to be completed
in 2019;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) details of designs and drawing to be
approved by CWC relating to Polavaram
Head Works and its present status?
Separate toilets for girls in schools
*9. SHRI DEREK O'BRIEN: Will the
Minister of DRINKING WA TER AND
SANITATION be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of schools in India
which have separate toilets for girls; and
(b) how many of these are functional
the details thereof, State-wise?

1
Blast at Central Ammunition Depot at
Pulgaon
1. SHRI HUSAIN DALW AI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any investigation has been
undertaken of ordnance factories on quality
and safety of ammunition produced
thereon;
(b) if so, details thereof and action taken
thereon and if not, reasons therefor;
(c) whether recent blast at Central
Ammunition Depot, Pulgaon was caused
due to substandard ammunition
manufactured at Ordnance Factory Board,
Khamaria, if so, details thereof;
(d) details of incidents of accident or
technical fault found With ordnances
manufactured at Khamaria, along with
details of investigation and action taken in
last three years; and
(e) the reason why factory continues to
manufacture ammunition despite serious
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
evidence of having produced substandard
ammunition past leading to accidents?
Purchase of bulletproof jackets for
soldiers
†2. MS. SAROJ PANDEY: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Government has purchased bulletproof
jackets for the soldiers; and
(b) if so, the number of bulletproof
jackets purchased and the expenditure
incurred by Government in this regard?
FDI in defence industries
3. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state
whether it is a fact that defence industries
have attracted USD 10,000 (about Rupees
Seven Lakh) only as Foreign Direct
Investment (FDI) in 2017-18?

2
Honey-trapping in armed forces
†4. SHRI VIJAY PAL SINGH
TOMAR: Will the  Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the incidents
of Honey-trap for spying purpose is
continuously increasing in armed forces;
(b) if so, whether Government is
considering to take any preventive
measures in this regard; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and details
of steps taken by Government to stop this?
Air Force rescue operation during
Kerala floods
5. SHRI ELAMARAM KAREEM:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
the Indian Air Force has asked for ` 25
crore from the State Government of Kerala
as the payment for facilities provided for
air lifting and rescue operations during
floods in Kerala;
(b) reasons for armed forces charging
such amount for the services they are bound
to provide for the citizens during emergency
situations;
(c) whether Government will initiate
measures to avoid such action by the Armed
Forces in the future; and
(d) whether Army and Navy are also
going to demand expenses for rescue
operations they had done in Kerala?
Promoting Intellectual Property
Rights in Defence
6. SHRI MD. NADIMUL HAQUE:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has taken any
measures to promote self-reliance in
Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs) in
Defence;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the impact of such measures on cost
savings; and
(d) the challenges faced by the Defence
sector in attracting private and public sector
entities for IPRs?
Reduction in number of armed forces
personnel
7. SHRI HISHEY LACHUNGPA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether there is a reduction in the
number of armed forces personnel;
(b) if so, the number of armed forces
personnel reduced in the three wings of
armed forces during the last three years;
and
(c) the reasons for reducing the number
of armed forces personnel?
Report of Shekatkar Committee
8. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the committee of experts
headed by retired Lt. General D.B.
Shekatkar, which was appointed to look
into certain aspects to enhance combat
capability and rebalance expenditure, has
submitted its report;
(b) if so, the salient features of the
report; and
(c) the details of steps taken by
Government to implement the
recommendations of the committee?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

3
Status of payments to HAL
9. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Hindustan
Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has been
adversely affected on account of stoppage
of due payments of ` 15,700 crore by
Government;
(b) whether it is a fact that huge amount
of arrears of payment of other contractors
is outstanding and if so, the details thereof;
and
(c) the specific reasons for not clearing
their dues and by when these are likely to
be cleared?
